rules.no_speculative_development: Prohibited to initiate work based on hypothetical improvements, aesthetics, or newly emerged technology.
rules.code_change_gate: A production code change is authorized ONLY with: OBSERVED_FAILURE + REPRODUCIBLE_EVIDENCE + FIRST_DIVERGENCE + BOUNDED_FIX + ACCEPTANCE_TEST.

recertification.full_4mp_trigger: Only when shared acquisition, discovery, frontier engine, database schema, or materialization logic is touched.

rules.technology_policy: RADAR_ONLY by default. Any new library/framework requires an unblockable obstacle, cost-benefit analysis, minimal proof, and rollback plan.
rules.autonomy: AUTOCLAW_ACTIONS = 0 during operational execution. AutoClaw is reserved solely as a diagnostic learning tool upon persistent unknown failures.
rules.data_safety: Never commit cookies, tokens, credentials, sessions, or browser profiles to Git.
